$Comment: Scope-2 wave-3 leg W3-F (design section 2.7, decision 32 - jar layer, ZERO progression): STANDALONE-RICH by design - this station is fully useful on its own (a classic direct convert loop: place raw fish, press use, get grilled fish) AND doubles as the multi-station ANCHOR the cutting board's PrepFish program claims by proximity+type (Anchors:{fire:{Station:'cookingfire',...}} on Actions/PrepFish.json). When claimed as a remote anchor, THIS station's own action is never invoked (design 2.2) - only its Custody claim (the anchor's own placed-input slot) and its block's State.Definitions (Default/Lit) matter; the program's own Steps execute at this anchor with the fire's presentation. No Puppet group is authored here (mirrors the Sawmill precedent - a classic non-Walk convert loop needs no puppet route). Custody.States.Loaded='Lit' names the block's own lit-campfire state variant (RPG_Station_CookingFire.json). Custody.Display is the flat Fish_Piece-model item prop - the placed item's OWN BlockType.CustomModel/CustomModelTexture renders through the item-route prop automatically (Food_Fish_Raw / Food_Fish_Grilled both model Resources/Ingredients/Fish_Piece.blockymodel with a raw-vs-roasted texture swap baked into each item, ledger [6cdea5ead]), so this Display group only needs Offset/Scale, never a model reference - Offset.Y is a first-pass placeholder, PROVISIONAL/in-game-unverified like every other shipped Custody.Display in this family. SEAM WAVE (decision 51c/52) re-authors onto native recipe truth: Recipe.FromCrafting.Benches:['Campfire'] + Types:['Processing'] document the REAL native Food_Fish_Grilled recipe (Input:[{ItemId:'Food_Fish_Raw'}], BenchRequirement:[{Id:'Campfire',Type:'Processing'}], TimeSeconds:2, ledger [6cdea5ead]) - the native BenchRequirement here carries NO Categories field at all, so the Sawmill's Categories-only derivation route genuinely cannot reach this recipe, which is exactly why Benches exists as a second derivation route. The hand-authored Conversions[] block is KEPT (not replaced) because the live station.StationRecipeDeriver still matches Categories only as of this wave (Benches decodes/documents now, deriver wiring is a follow-on leg per StationValidator's FROMCRAFTING_BENCHES_NOT_YET_DERIVED advisory) - this is the EFFECTIVE conversion today, unchanged. NativeTime{Scale:1.0,OffsetMs:500} is the linear transform (decision 52, y=Scale*TimeSeconds_ms+OffsetMs) that reproduces the CURRENT effective pacing from the native TimeSeconds truth (1.0*2000+500=2500ms, matching Work.CycleMs below byte-for-byte) so the knob is ready the moment the deriver honors it, with zero pacing change today (Conversion carries no DurationMs, so Work.CycleMs stays the sole live cadence source).
